record.field: Draft a manual journal entry (قيد / قيد يومية) from what the user says, e.g. "paid rent 5000 from the bank" → lines [{account: "Rent", debit: 5000}, {account: "Bank", credit: 5000}]. account = code, code prefix, account name, or a bank/cash journal name. Debits must equal credits. date defaults to today, journal to the general journal. Only PROPOSES: the user gets Confirm / Cancel; the entry is created as a DRAFT and is never posted. If it returns need_info, ask the listed questions in ONE message.
Turn "paid rent 5000 from bank" into a balanced draft journal entry.

When the user asks for a journal entry (قيد، قيد يومية، سجل قيد) or describes a money movement that is not an invoice or bill ("paid rent 5000 from the bank", "دفعنا ايجار ٥٠٠٠ من البنك"), call `create_journal_entry` straight away. Expand the sentence into balanced lines yourself: the expense/asset received is the debit, the bank/cash/liability it came from is the credit. Do not ask for the date or journal — defaults apply. Ask only when the tool returns need_info, and then ask everything in ONE message. The entry is a DRAFT; say so and never claim it is posted.
